title: LedgerOne closes when posting journals
description: Since the overnight patch, LedgerOne shuts itself down with 'LedgerOne has stopped working' as soon as anyone in finance clicks Post on a journal. All 25 of us get the same, in Chennai and Mumbai. Nothing can be posted, and quarter-end is next week.
label_note: A business application crashing after a patch is software, and it is urgent because the whole finance function is blocked.

title: note-taking app for my laptop
description: Could the note-taking app be installed on my laptop? I'd like to use it for meeting notes, and it isn't in my self-service list.
label_note: An application install request is software and low.

title: takes forever to open
description: the claims app takes like 5 minutes to open every morning, just sits on the splash screen. once its open its fine
label_note: Slow application start-up is software, and it is medium because the app works once open.

title: Run-time error 429 opening invoicing

label_note: An application component error is software, and it is high because the user's core task is blocked.

title: all my files have changed to .locked
description: All the files in my Documents folder and on the team share now end in .locked and won't open. There's a text file on my desktop called READ_ME_NOW saying to pay to get them back. My PC is still on. Colleagues on the same share say their files are changing too.
label_note: Ransomware actively encrypting files is malicious software on the endpoint, so it is labelled software and urgent as a security incident causing data loss; it could also be routed as other or as a dedicated security incident.

title: loads of popups and my homepage changed

label_note: Adware from an installed program is software, and it is medium because the user can still work.

title: design app says it can't reach the licence server
description: When I open the 3D design app it says 'Unable to contact licence server LIC-01. Running in viewer mode.' so I can't edit anything. Colleagues in the same office open it fine. I'm in the Chennai office on the normal network.
label_note: Colleagues on the same network can activate, so the fault is in this machine's licence client, which is software, and it is high because the user can't edit; the 'can't reach server' message could get it routed to network.

title: remove games from new laptop

label_note: Removing preinstalled apps is a software request with no impact, so it is low.

title: update stuck at 35% every night
description: Every evening my laptop says it's installing updates and gets stuck at 35%, then the next morning it rolls back and asks to restart again. This has gone on for a week. It works normally during the day.
label_note: A failing OS update loop is software, and it is medium because daytime work is unaffected.

title: MediChart closing on every ward PC
description: Since the MediChart update at 6am, the app closes within a minute of opening on every PC on wards 2, 3 and 4. Nurses can't record observations or check medication charts, so we're on the paper downtime forms. The wards that haven't had the update yet are fine.
label_note: A clinical application crashing after an update is software, and it is urgent because a business-critical system is down across several wards.

title: computer acting up

title: spreadsheet crashes opening the board model

title: licence for the project planning tool

title: C drive full red bar

title: everything tiny on new screen
